script_text: Earth signs — a rare Mars-Jupiter conjunction will shake your career foundation hard this week. Mercury in Leo squares your Taurus Sun in the 1st House from Monday through Wednesday, breeding deep miscommunication and frustrating self-doubt. A Mars trine Jupiter quietly activates your 10th House on Monday, and Tuesday is the roughest day. Thursday transforms everything as Venus enters Scorpio, flooding your 8th House with a hidden love interest of magnetic intensity. Over the weekend, Venus trines Neptune in Pisces, revealing emotional clarity in your 7th House and a financial truth about shared resources. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters Scorpio, activating transformative passion in your 8th House. Tuesday is your worst day — Mercury squares your Sun in the 1st House, clouding judgment and breeding unnecessary conflict. Write your career goals on paper before the Mars-Jupiter window closes — the 10th House won't wait. Follow for daily updates.
